Appearance:
MR BHAVIK J PANDYA(5002) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2,3,4,5 MR MANISH J PATEL(2131) for the Applicant(s) No. 1,2,3,4,5 NOTICE SERVED for the Opponent(s) No. 1 ==================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ASHUTOSH SHASTRI  and  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE J. C. DOSHI  Date : 13/04/2023

sentences.text: ORAL ORDER (PER : HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ASHUTOSH SHASTRI)

[1] By way of this contempt petition,
a willful disobedience is alleged of an order dated 26.8.2022 passed in Special Civil Application No.9578 of 2018 by which, 8 weeks' time was granted to the authority to pass an award.

Operative part of said order contained in paragraph 6 reads as under:-
6.

sentences.text: (iii) Costs made easy  C/MCA/326/2023 ORDER DATED: 13/04/2023 [2] Since time limit has not been observed by original respondent No.3, applicants were constrained to initiate present contempt proceedings.
[3] Since this was the grievance contained in present petition, Coordinate Bench was pleased to issue notice upon the authority vide order dated 13.3.2023.

[4] In response to the said notice, today when the matter is taken up for hearing, learned Assistant Government Pleader Mr. Jainil Parikh has tendered Further Affidavit filed on behalf of respondent No.1 and in presence of an officer has requested that some reasonable time be extended to complete entire proceedings and it has been stated that though in Further Affidavit-in-Reply, five months'
time is sought for to complete the process, but considering previous directions and long passage of time having elapsed, a request is made to grant reasonable time as the Court may deem it proper.

[ 5 ] Considering the peculiarity of circumstance and in view of the previous orders, we deem it proper to finally grant two months' time to comply with direction issued by the Court and this extension of two months' time is clearly understood by an officer as final extension and no further time will be extended.

[6] It is made clear that if direction as indicated above is not adhered to even within this extended period of two months, C/MCA/326/2023 ORDER DATED: 13/04/2023 appropriates steps will be taken against responsible officer.

[7] Normally, we would not have extended the time, but in view of the fact that there is a broad consensus even by learned advocate appearing for applicants, this final extension is granted and since same is assured to be complied with, we deem it proper to close present contempt proceedings.
Accordingly, present Misc. Civil Application stands DISPOSED OF.
